pure-announcement.rationale: It is not literally a product launch, release note, or funding announcement — it is a gated lead-generation landing page teasing a downloadable Snyk report.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts cover SIEM visibility and MCP governance mechanisms, while this page's only content is teaser statistics about AI-BOM-measured adoption, so nothing here is covered by them.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The headline numbers are attributed to a described dataset (anonymized AI-BOM telemetry from 500+ Evo by Snyk assessments) and the full report is linked, so the claims are checkable in principle.

durability.rationale: The page carries nothing but 2026 adoption-snapshot teasers ('1 in 4 organizations', '3x larger footprint') from one vendor's customer sample, with no mechanism or pattern that would still be useful in twelve months.

actionability.rationale: There is nothing to act on: every substantive finding sits behind the download form, and the visible bullets only advertise what the report would explain.

atomicity.rationale: No core idea is developed at all — the page is four disjoint chapter teasers, none of which can be stated as a claim independent of the marketing framing.
